title: Vertical scaling (VPA) and cluster node autoscaling

videos.script: The horizontal autoscaler changes how many pods there are. Two other questions are left. {{two}} Is each pod the right size? The Vertical Pod Autoscaler watches what pods use over time and recommends requests, which is lesson 21's measurement done continuously. {{vpa}} And when the pods no longer fit, who adds a machine? That is the cluster autoscaler, which grows and shrinks the set of nodes. {{nodes}} You will run the recommender against a busy shop, read what it suggests, and then change a running pod's requests without restarting it, something Kubernetes could not do until recently. {{plan}}
